_doc: ⚑ S207 — THE PAUSES AND THE WAYS BACK (his, 2026-10-01: 'I don't want to see this as a full fork… elements of pause where people can better understand that the rest of the elements can have a way to be interacted with and not just lost in the void. Maybe there is information that needs to be disclosed in the system'; 'yes, build the four pauses and the ways back… see if they make sense when building them'). Plan: docs/reinterp/SKETCH_BRANCHES_AND_SIDE_DOORS_2026-10-01.md §4. ONE PAUSE PER ERA, once, at a moment the main path is waiting anyway, in the era's own software, listing only what has not been opened yet (read live from data/strings/map.json's optional beats — nothing here goes stale). THE WAYS BACK: when an optional thing is closed, the era's voice names the main path's current step (map.json's label). Seller's voice throughout — operable register; the satire is the system's, and it is never about the person. ⚑ THE EXCEPTIONS, by law: what people made for each other never pushes back — Caleb's song, the radio-hour tape, Tape C, the outtake on Tape 04, the ball. None of those calls wayBack.

e1.title: Un-Walk — Did you know?

e1.outro: Every part of the kit is part of your programme.
